newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Borotra defends car incentive scheme.
newsitem.headline: France's Borotra defends car incentive scheme.

text.p: Industry Minister Franck Borotra defended the principle of a state car incentive scheme on Thursday but said no decision had been taken whether to extend it beyond its scheduled expiry on September 30.

"No decision has been taken," he told the newspaper Les Echos. "I've put some proposals to the prime minister and it's up to him to decide. I feel that the supports to the car industry...generate more in terms of activity and tax receipts than they cost."
The year-long scheme was introduced last October, three months after a previous new-cars-for-old scheme ended.
